latin_incipit: In omni demonstratione praeteri illam quae est omnino absoluta: potes circularis ratiocinatio.
english_translation: In every demonstration (except the most absolute), circular reasoning can occur.
exegesis: This explores the epistemological structure of knowledge and the risk of hidden circularity in logical proofs, a critical insight into the limits of rational demonstration.

scholar_citations.work: Syncretism in the West: Pico's Platform

notes: Philosophical insight into the limits of rational demonstration; supports Pico's openness to non-discursive forms of knowledge (intuition, revelation).
